transcript: Myself I am finally a software engineering student and I like system analysis work. I know some point modeling, documentation and my SQL. I did bus tracking mobile lab for transport. better_answer_example: In my recent project, a bus tracking mobile lab, I worked on road tracking and live location updates. We encountered significant challenges, including GPS delays and inaccurate location updates. Through persistent effort and collaboration with my team, we were able to resolve these issues by implementing more efficient data processing algorithms and adjusting our location update intervals. This experience not only deepened my understanding of system analysis but also taught me valuable lessons in teamwork and problem-solving, skills that I believe are essential for this role in IT.
